summary: A black-and-white site for the free Redaction family, commissioned for Titus Kaphar and Reginald Dwayne Betts's exhibition on court fines. Its idea is the family's six progressively pixel-damaged cuts, shown through a degrading hero, a slider tester, draggable glyph tiles and a legal essay on a folded sheet; a flag-shaped custom cursor runs through the whole page.

instances.look: White 'redaction' at 230px centred on black, a small credit line and a white pill with the venue; a black-and-white American-flag cursor sits top left in every stitched crop
instances.ux: The block is .type-slider and preloads the cuts f-0–f-6 with bold and italic: the word likely steps through the degraded cuts with the pointer or on a timer; no degradation was visible in the capture. The cursor is replaced by a small flag SVG
instances.learn: Swap the arrow cursor for a loaded symbol: the flag follows the visitor through a site about the justice system, and it costs one SVG

reconstruction.layout: Full-bleed 100vh black; word centred at ~y=310; description 14px centred at y≈540; venue pill below it. Custom flag cursor ~85×46px
reconstruction.typography: 'redaction' 230px Redaction Regular white, lowercase; description ~14px Redaction, italic title; pill ~13px black on white
reconstruction.behaviour: All seven cuts preloaded in hidden .pre spans so swaps don't flash. Probably pointer-driven swapping of cut (.type-slider); not verified from capture. Mobile shows a giant 'R' instead
reconstruction.content: Title, credit, 'NXTHVN / August – September 26' venue link

instances.look: 'Marbury v.' at 173px, with a solid black bar in the place of 'Madison' on the second line, centred on white

instances.ux: The second word is hidden by the bar; .type-redactor suggests a hover or pointer reveal of the name beneath. Only desktop has it; absent on mobile
instances.learn: Enact the subject on the specimen: a redacted line of real case law states the concept with no explanation

reconstruction.layout: 1170px tall section (130vh), two centred lines; bar ~776×192px directly under line 1, covering the second word
reconstruction.typography: 173px Redaction Regular black; second line (hidden) same size in black on black
reconstruction.behaviour: h2 inside .two with black background over black text; likely pointer interaction reveals it; not observed
reconstruction.content: A landmark US Supreme Court case name; component .cases may hold others

instances.look: Canvas: three white 'S' at ~300px (Italic, Regular, Bold) in a row on black with tiny labels, and a large white disc partly off the top left corner
instances.ux: Canvas drawn with Paper.js; the disc probably follows the pointer or inverts what it covers. Not visible on mobile
instances.learn: Reduce a family overview to one letter in three styles at huge size: the differences do the talking

reconstruction.typography: ~300px Redaction Italic, Regular, Bold rendered as canvas text; labels ~12px Redaction

instances.variantDefinition: Overlapping square tiles of huge cropped glyphs (some animated GIFs) that the visitor can drag and resize into their own collage; the specimen is a pile of cards on a table rather than a fixed layout.
instances.look: Seven overlapping black or white squares, each cropping one huge glyph (&, n, a pixelated X, a comma-like shape, !, /5), scattered on white
instances.feel: Evidence photos spread on a desk
instances.ux: Each tile can be dragged and resized by edge handles; some contain animated GIFs by Zipeng Zhu with a JPG fallback. On mobile the tiles stack in a column
instances.learn: Give the visitor a heap of cropped letters to push around: curating a collage makes them look at details they would scroll past

reconstruction.layout: 1080px tall (120vh); seven ~250–406px absolute squares, overlapping, with z-order by last touched; some 1px outlined white on white
reconstruction.typography: Glyph images, not live text: crops of Redaction and damaged cuts
reconstruction.behaviour: vue-draggable-resizable: .drag-item.draggable.resizable.vdr with eight .handle-* shown on activation; animation images a_N.gif above a_N.jpg
reconstruction.content: Single glyphs chosen for their shape
reconstruction.assets: Seven animated glyph GIFs with JPG posters (/static/animations/a_1–7)

instances.look: A white sheet with a folded top-right corner on a black ground, holding a headline, the essay and images in a contained scroll area with a square scrollbar thumb on a grey rail
instances.feel: A legal document in a file
instances.ux: The sheet scrolls internally (perfect-scrollbar); most of the essay and its images sit outside the capture and were read from HTML only
instances.learn: Style the long read as the object it talks about: a fold and a tall custom scrollbar turn a modal into a document

reconstruction.layout: Section 1170px tall on black; sheet x=85–1355, y=262–910, clipped by a polygon top-right corner (~200px fold in grey #d6d6d6); text 840px column, scrollbar rail 50px wide, right edge, starting below the fold

reconstruction.behaviour: perfect-scrollbar in the sheet; square 50×50px outlined thumb
reconstruction.content: Real essay on the exhibition, Civil Rights Corps documents, court fines and fees; redact-1–5 and other images

instances.look: A single input with grey placeholder 'make history.' at 104px, then three circled buttons r, b, i and one long hairline slider
instances.feel: A form with a charged prompt
instances.ux: Type; pick regular, bold or italic; drag the slider to step through the seven cuts from clean to damaged (fonts f-0…f-6)
instances.learn: Treat a stepped set of files as an axis: one slider across separate fonts feels like variable type with no variable font

reconstruction.layout: 100vh; input ~1040px wide, centred; config row ~y=520: three 30px circles at left and a 700px slider, thumb 30px outlined circle

reconstruction.behaviour: Buttons swap style; slider (vue-slide-bar) maps to Redaction, 10, 20, 35, 50, 70, 100 family swap; placeholder clears on focus, returns on blur

instances.look: Black screen with a huge radio circle + 'Agree' at 206px, and 'Download' at the same size reversed on a white strip
instances.ux: Tick Agree to enable the download; the agreement is a huge display word rather than small print. Open Font License is linked elsewhere
instances.learn: Make consent the headline: two words at 200px turn the dullest step into the page's final act
